[Act: cpc
 Chapter: Plaint
 Section: O7R13::Where rejection of plaint does not preclude presentation of fresh plaint.
]


The rejection of the plaint on any of the grounds hereinbefore mentioned shall not of its own force preclude the plaintiff from presenting a fresh plaint in respect of the same cause of action.

metadata.section_title: Where rejection of plaint does not preclude presentation of fresh plaint.
